interpretation: Values are approximate summaries of the linked exact artifact, NOT VQA accuracy. Native question formatting/context aids dataset identification. Image-only routing remains weaker after stem normalization, but this is not a pure formatting intervention because options/OCR are removed too.
implementation: Add router_text raw|stem. Stem is first nonempty question line after removing <image>, whitespace-normalized, casefolded, terminal .?! stripped. Only router features use stem; actual VQA model always retains original complete question/options/OCR.
primary: Keep raw joint routing as declared; do not replace the primary on final evaluation results.
ablation: Evaluate stem-joint, raw-image, raw-question routing using identical expert training/settings, alongside raw-joint. Select any independently tuned deployment variant on validation only. Report reduced-context routing as robustness analysis, not a claim of fully format-invariant semantics.
